Test a full‑pool weighted combination with softmax_neg_error to see if expanding the pool improves robustness given the unstable ranking and strong seasonal signal.
Test a robust weighted combo using inverse error on the full pool to see if simple error‑based weighting beats the softmax approach.
test a plain mean across the full model set
The series has unstable ranking (tau 0.018) and strong seasonality; a robust median may outperform weighted combos.
The series has unstable ranking (tau≈0) and many correlated groups; a per‑horizon best‑model weighting could capture horizon‑specific strengths.
The series has strong seasonality and unstable ranking; a trimmed mean may provide robustness by discarding extreme models.
The series has strong trend and seasonality with unstable ranking; a trimmed mean on the robust 6‑model pool (pool4) could reduce influence of outliers and improve robustness.
test a simple mean over the stable 6‑model pool (trend strong, seasonality strong, ranking unstable) to see if robustness beats weighted combos.
Test a per‑horizon weighted combination on the stable 6‑model pool (trend/seasonality strong, ranking unstable) to see if horizon‑specific best models improve the robust leader.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w2' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.939. Series context: trend strength 0.9995 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.018); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.742.
